name: GoalPrevail Floating Button
author: Goal Prevail

sections.description:
GoalPrevail Floating Button adds a sticky call-to-action button to the bottom of your site — perfect for click-to-call, WhatsApp chats, contact links, or any URL you want visitors to reach in one tap.

It is lightweight (one tiny script, no jQuery on the front end, no external requests), works with any theme, and gives you control over every detail without writing code.

One-tap actions

  • Call a phone number (click-to-call on mobile)
  • Open a WhatsApp chat via wa.me
  • Compose an email or send an SMS
  • Open any link — booking pages, contact forms, promotions
  • Scroll back to top

Up to three buttons at once

  • Enable left, center and right independently — run one, two, or all three
  • Each button has its own action, text, icon and placement
  • A shared look keeps them consistent by default; flip on independent styling for any position to give it its own colors, icon, size and animation
  • Per-position click analytics show which corner earns the taps

Position & behavior

  • Bottom left, center, or right — pick it right on activation
  • Exact distance from the bottom and side edges
  • Show always, or only after the visitor scrolls
  • Show on all devices, mobile only, or desktop only
  • Full-width bar mode and icon-only mode for small screens
  • Hide on specific pages by ID
  • Entrance effects (fade, rise) and attention animations (pulse, bounce, wobble, float) that respect the visitor’s reduced-motion preference

Design every detail

  • Background, text, hover, and border colors with color pickers
  • 19 built-in SVG icons (phone, WhatsApp, chat, email, cart, calendar, and more) — placed before/after text or icon-only
  • Fonts: theme default, system stacks, web-safe families, or your own custom family
  • Font size, weight, transform, and letter spacing
  • Width, height, paddings, border width/style, corner radius
  • Shadow presets and hover lift

Built-in click analytics

See today’s clicks, the last 7 and 30 days, an all-time total, and a 14-day chart — right in the settings page. Tracking stores anonymous daily counters only: no IP addresses, no cookies, no personal data, nothing sent to third parties.

Lightweight & safe

  • No front-end assets load at all while the button is disabled or unconfigured
  • One small vanilla-JS file and inline CSS when it is active
  • All settings sanitized and escaped following WordPress coding standards

GoalPrevail Floating Button is built by Goal Prevail. If you run WooCommerce, check out our premium plugin GP Cart Button Master for customizable add-to-cart buttons, direct checkout, and a floating mobile cart button.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/goalprevail-floating-button, or install it via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Pick a position (left, center, right) on the welcome screen.
  4. Add your phone number, WhatsApp number, email, or link in that position’s Content section under GoalPrevail → Floating Button.
  5. Style it to match your brand and save.
sections.faq:
Why is the button not showing?

A button only appears once it has something to do: add a phone number, email, or link in its Content section. Also check that its “Show the … button” toggle is on and the current page is not in your excluded IDs.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes — it is designed mobile-first. You can show it on mobile only, stretch it to a full-width bar on phones, or switch to icon-only on small screens.

Does it slow my site down?

No. When active it adds one small script (about 1 KB gzipped) and a few lines of inline CSS. When disabled, nothing loads at all.

What data does click tracking store?

Only anonymous totals: one counter per day plus an all-time sum. No IP addresses, cookies, or personal information are stored, and nothing is sent to any external service. You can disable tracking or reset the numbers at any time.

Can I use my own icon or font?

You can pick from 19 built-in icons, and type any font family your theme already loads. Custom icon upload is planned for the Pro version.

Can I run more than one button?

Yes — up to three at once (bottom left, center and right), each with its own action, content and optional independent styling. Every button supports per-page exclusions by ID; finer page targeting is planned for the Pro version.

Does removing the plugin leave data behind?

By default your settings are kept in case you reinstall. Enable “Delete all plugin data on uninstall” under Advanced to remove everything.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Run up to three floating buttons at once (bottom left / center / right), each enabled independently.
  • Actions: phone call, WhatsApp, email, SMS, custom URL, scroll-to-top.
  • Shared look by default, with a per-button “independent styling” toggle.
  • Full styling: colors, 19 built-in SVG icons, fonts, sizes, paddings, borders, radius, shadows and attention animations.
  • Behavior: show after scroll, entrance effects, device targeting, full-width and icon-only mobile modes, page exclusions.
  • Anonymous per-position click analytics with today / 7-day / 30-day / all-time stats and a 14-day chart.
  • Live preview and style presets.
